input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 gives Client (and only Client) a unilateral right to terminate at will on written notice, with services running to the last day of the month following the notice month — an effective notice period of roughly 30 to 60 days, with no early-termination fee, penalty or other exit charge. That meets, and on the fee point exceeds, our preferred position (30 days' notice without penalty). TrueLink has no mid-term termination-for-convenience right: Section 13 sets a one-year term auto-renewing for successive one-year periods, and the only TrueLink exit is the mutual 30-day notice of intent not to renew at the end of a year (plus for-cause termination of Sections 2 and 3 on Client breach), so the walk-away scenario (Vendor convenience termination mid-term) does not arise. Two minor points noted but not redlined: (i) there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, which is immaterial here because Section 5(a) bills Hosting and Support Services monthly in arrears against invoices payable within 15 days, so no material prepayment accrues; and (ii) the end-of-term non-renewal notice is 30 days rather than the 90 days contemplated for a Vendor end-of-term exit, but that right is symmetric, applies only at expiry of a one-year term, and equally preserves our own flexibility, so it benefits us as much as TrueLink.
